scenarios.name: reveal-instant-transforms
scenarios.why: In seat 0's upkeep the top card is Brainstorm (an instant); seat 0 reveals it, so Delver transforms into Insectile Aberration, a 3/2 flier.

scenarios.name: land-on-top-no-transform
scenarios.why: The top card is an Island: even if revealed it is not an instant or sorcery, so Delver stays a 1/1 without flying.

scenarios.name: declining-to-reveal-no-transform
scenarios.why: Revealing is optional: if seat 0 does not reveal the instant, nothing is 'revealed this way' and Delver does not transform.
